description: Run AI clip-suggestion analysis on a long-form media item — the CLIPPING path (find the best short-form moments). Returns { status, alreadyRunning? }; then wait_job(kind="suggestions", id=mediaItemId) — its terminal lists each suggestion WITH its briefId. When the media belongs to a PROJECT, each finalized suggestion is promoted to a kind-'clip' BRIEF (its window pinned as a beat) — list_briefs {kind:"clip"} shows them and compose({ briefId }) runs the flagship path from one. Project-less media: pass the suggestion id to compose({ suggestionId }) directly. Clipping is a vertical, NOT the general path.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.
